hero.headline: Check a certificate before you trust it.
hero.sentence: Scan the QR on the page, type its ID, or upload a scan. You get a clear answer, and the reasons behind it.
hero.reassurance: No sign-in needed. Uploaded files are deleted after {days} days.

roads.road_a_desc: Signed by the institution. Any change breaks it.
roads.road_b_desc: We read it, compare it with the institution's record and look for signs of editing. We can warn you. We cannot prove it.

VERIFIED_ISSUER_SIGNED.headline: Verified
VERIFIED_ISSUER_SIGNED.sentence: Signed by {institution} on {date}. Nothing has changed since, and it has not been withdrawn.

VERIFIED_PENDING_ANCHOR.headline: Verified, sealing in progress
VERIFIED_PENDING_ANCHOR.sentence: The signature is valid. The record joins the public log in about {minutes} minutes.

INVALID_SIGNATURE.headline: Do not trust this document
INVALID_SIGNATURE.sentence: The content does not match what the institution signed.

ISSUER_NOT_APPROVED.headline: Issuer not approved
ISSUER_NOT_APPROVED.sentence: The institution that signed this is not approved on Sanad.

KEY_WINDOW_UNSAFE.headline: Signed with a key later reported unsafe
KEY_WINDOW_UNSAFE.sentence: We cannot show this was signed before the key was reported unsafe.

NOT_FOUND.headline: No such certificate
NOT_FOUND.sentence: We have no certificate with this ID. Check the ID, or ask for the QR version.

CONSISTENT_WITH_REGISTRY.headline: Matches the record (advisory)
CONSISTENT_WITH_REGISTRY.sentence: The details on your scan match a record. A scan cannot be proven genuine. Ask for the QR version to be sure.

NEEDS_REVIEW.headline: Needs a human check
NEEDS_REVIEW.sentence: Some details or signs on this scan do not agree. Ask the institution to confirm.

LIKELY_ALTERED.headline: Likely altered
LIKELY_ALTERED.sentence: A key detail contradicts the institution's record.

CANNOT_VERIFY.headline: Cannot verify
CANNOT_VERIFY.sentence: No matching record was found, or the scan was not clear enough to read.
